reviews.title: El vendedor de humo
reviews.text:
A diario, sin merecer la apreciación de los usuarios, vende promesas como si fueran soluciones. Te hace creer que su servicio funciona, que todo está bien y que cualquier problema será solucionado.

Pagas por un traductor que supuestamente hará un buen trabajo, pero recibes palabras incorrectas, traducciones que no tienen sentido y resultados que no corresponden con lo que pagaste.

Y cuando reclamas, comienza el mismo discurso: “Escríbenos al correo”, “daremos una solución”, “lo vamos a arreglar”. Pero la solución nunca llega.

Eso es vender humo: crear expectativas, prometer resultados, cobrar por ellos y después esconderse detrás de excusas y promesas vacías.

El humo no se puede agarrar, no se puede guardar y tampoco deja resultados. Solo desaparece después de haber hecho perder el tiempo y el dinero a quien confió.

Prometer no enpobrece , muchas promesas y muy pocas soluciones… porque prometer y no cumplir es fácil, pero ponerlas en práctica es otra historia.

reviews.title: Kitill
reviews.text:
I purchased this app because the advertising claims that it can translate conversations, phone calls, and provide real-time translation through headphones.

Unfortunately, my experience has been very different.

I use AirPods and expected the app to continuously listen to nearby English speech through my iPhone and play the Russian translation in my ear. However, this does not work as advertised. The app does not clearly explain how to set up real-time headphone translation, and there is no obvious way to keep translation running reliably while using AirPods.

The advertising gives the impression that seamless real-time translation is available, but in practice it is difficult or impossible to achieve the workflow shown in the promotional materials.

If there is a specific setup required, it should be explained clearly. Otherwise, the marketing is misleading and creates expectations that the app does not meet.

I would appreciate a response from the developer explaining exactly how real-time headphone translation and phone call translation are supposed to work on iPhone.

So I agreed to pay the monthly amount to check it out, as soon as I accepted the subscription I used it for 5 minutes realized it was not what was advertised and it didnt responded to any “live translation “  I went to cancel my subscription and realized they took the full yearly plan out my account, I am now waiting to hear back from apple about this.
WOULD NOT RECOMMEND WASTING YOUR TIME WITH THIS APP.

reviews.title: Languages
reviews.text: You have to pay upfront before you know what languages that it translates. Unfortunately I don’t need any of f these translate.  Waste of money.  Plus it couldn’t even translate English to Spanish when I tried

reviews.title: 無法即時翻譯
reviews.text: 在越南與客戶對話，無法像畫面一樣即時翻譯，操作也無說明，如何優化或解決問題，打字翻譯也不夠準確，能申請退費不？

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: I got roped into into paying for this app  it doesn’t work to translate Thai to English at all. I want my money back. I assume I won’t get it. If that’s the case then I would call it scam ware.

reviews.title: Not real time translation, it’s just consecutive
reviews.text: Accuracy is terrible from English to Japanese.  This is also not the real real-time.  It’s just a slow latency consecutive translation.  I accidentally signed up for 1 year subscription, since there is no free trial. After 15 min of usage, I wanted to delete it, but I cannot get the money back.

reviews.title: Poor performance
reviews.text: He translates for himself and moves ahead of schedule. I am very upset and want to cancel my order.

reviews.title: Very Poor Translation
reviews.text: I downloaded and asked my wife who is Indonesian to speak in Bahasa. The translation was delayed. Missed most of the conversation and was probably 50% accurate on the words it translated. I immediately cancelled.

reviews.title: Instant failure
reviews.text: One minute into trying the app out and it couldn’t translate Filipino using the voice option if the apps life was dependent on it. You have to type in what you want. I could have done that with Google translate.

reviews.title: Cumbersome
reviews.text: Too many options and not intuitive.   Voice recognition very poor

reviews.title: Installed and then deleted
reviews.text: What is the purpose of not having a free trial. Im not going to pay for something that i cannot try first.  Sorry but i am not taking that risk just to find out it isn’t as good as it’s made out to be.

reviews.title: This is supposed to be free!!!!!!
reviews.text: The first thing one sees is the packages. It is a scam in that it says it is supposed to be free and it patently IS NOT!!!

reviews.title: Deceptive payment options
reviews.text: I thought The app was only four dollars and something a month. Turns out they charge you for the whole year at once but then tell me that.

reviews.title: 中翻英錯誤
reviews.text: 我打：我要如何搭捷運？翻英文卻變成How do I take the underground（我要怎樣拿到地底下）這根本連文法都錯誤，還敢要收錢，早早下架吧。正確翻英文為「How can I take the subway?」這才是正解。

reviews.title: Payment
reviews.text: The app. Works great, but I paid for the year than got kicked off the next day and now it’s asking me to pay again and restore.

reviews.title: Not that great and is expensive
reviews.text: I got download it today and they don’t offer a free trial. I click on $4.99 a month but when I clicked pay it charge me for the year. So now I can’t cancel for at least a year. Very frustrating and misleading. The main problem I have is when I text translate, it will won’t let me click the speaker button. It says the translation is not available at this time. It’ll translate the word, but it will not say the word which is a problem and makes no sense because when I do the conversation mode, it says the words just fine. This app is not that good and it’s a waste of money.

reviews.title: Voice doesn’t work
reviews.text: I had a full sentence I tried to use multiple times in Spanish and it just kept translating “hola” into “hello”. She never even said “Hola”! It wasn’t a word used! Disappointed.

reviews.title: No use without paying
reviews.text: Try to do a test translation from Italian to English, all I got was pop-ups telling me the various payment plans I could establish for myself. Deleted.
